notes.title: 2 new levels available
notes.notes:
Square Head Zombies 2 has 2 new levels available.
Now the game has a total of 19 levels.
More zombies are awaiting you on new levels.

notes.title: Level complete loop bug is fixed
notes.notes:
Some users related a problem when complete a level. The game just restarted the same level. I fix this bug now.
Allow Steam client to update the game to get the fix.

notes.title: Bug fix about mouse cursor
notes.notes: A player of the game related that find a bug about the mouse cursor is getting out of the screen without any reasons. I check it and fix the bug now.

notes.title: New levels available
notes.notes: Square Head Zombies 2 got new levels. Allow Steam client to update the app and play the new levels now.

notes.title: New levels and new weapon
notes.notes:
5 new levels and 1 new weapon are available now, allow Steam client update the game.

If you find any bug in this update, please write a message here

notes.title: Fix bugs in some menus
notes.notes: I release an update that fixes bugs in some menus. Working now in new levels.

notes.title: Change sound and volume game
notes.notes:
I create an update that let the player change the sound and music volume inside the game. Some users complain about that, I create this update to fix this.

If you see any problem about that, please post a message here.

notes.title: Fix weapon position when running
notes.notes: Many users complain when the player is running, the weapon cover the entire screen. I fix this problem now.

notes.title: Get a discount when purchase Square Head Zombies 1 and 2
notes.notes:
Now you can get a discount to purchase Square Head Zombies 1 and 2.
Go to the link below and get the games with discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7267/Square_Head_Zombie_Collection/

If you already have one game and don't have the other, you can get the discount for the game that you don't have it yet.
